_comment: 立绘差分：每个角色的表情/动作。用这里的描述让图像模型（fal.ai gpt-image-2.5-sunburst，见 tools/fal_image.py）从 art/sprites/<角色>.png 改画出 art/sprites/<角色>_<差分>.png。

kongkong.who: Kongkong the Taoist, an old man with a long white beard holding a book and a horsetail whisk

variants.smile: kindly amused smile with creased eyes, one hand stroking his long white beard
variants.ask: earnest questioning look, eyebrows raised, leaning slightly forward, holding the book open toward the viewer as if quizzing them

baoyu.who: Jia Baoyu, a handsome teenage young master

variants.smile: delighted warm smile, bright eyes, head tilted with curious fondness, as if meeting someone he feels he has known before
variants.angry: sudden outburst of anger, brows knitted, mouth open shouting, one arm raised high about to hurl down a jade pendant held in his fist
variants.timid: nervous and cowed, head lowered, shoulders hunched, hands clasped respectfully in front, eyes glancing up warily as before a strict father
variants.proud: eager and confident, one hand raised in an elegant gesture as if proposing a clever idea, bright animated face
variants.tearful: grief-stricken, tears streaming down his cheeks, brows knit in anguish, both hands reaching forward as if grasping a dying friend's hand

daiyu.who: Lin Daiyu, a delicate, frail young lady

variants.sneer: cold proud little sneer, chin slightly raised, half-lidded eyes glancing sideways with disdain, one corner of the lips curled, handkerchief held at her waist
variants.smile: playful teasing smile, sparkling eyes, lightly covering her mouth with a handkerchief as she laughs
variants.tearful: sorrowful, eyes brimming with tears, brows knit, dabbing a tear with a handkerchief, head bowed slightly

baochai.who: Xue Baochai, a composed, graceful young lady

variants.smile: gentle composed knowing smile, calm warm eyes, one hand raised slightly as if giving kind advice
variants.shy: demure embarrassment, eyes lowered, faint blush, head turned slightly away, fingers touching a golden locket at her chest
variants.stern: mild but firm reproof, calm composed face with a slight frown, eyes glancing sideways sternly, one hand raised slightly as if checking a servant

fengjie.who: Wang Xifeng, a glamorous, sharp-witted young matron

variants.smile: bright laughing smile, charismatic and gracious, one hand raised holding a handkerchief as she laughs
variants.scheme: sly cold smile, eyes narrowed and calculating, one corner of the mouth curled, hands tucked into her sleeves
variants.stern: imperious and severe, sharp brows, chin up, fierce eyes, pointing a finger in command
variants.troubled: startled and uneasy, eyes wide, brows knit with worry, one hand pressed to her chest

laolao.who: Granny Liu, a poor, stooped old country woman

variants.plead: humble awkward smile, bowing slightly, both hands clasped in front in supplication
variants.joy: overjoyed grin with crinkled eyes, both hands raised together in thanks

variants.ponder: hesitating and calculating, brows furrowed, one hand stroking his beard, eyes looking aside
variants.sly: self-serving sly smile, shifty eyes, one hand making a small dismissive wave
variants.earnest: suddenly grave and earnest, eyebrows raised sternly, one hand raised palm-out to cut the other speaker short, as if declaring 'Not so!' and about to lecture

jinghuan.who: the Goddess of Disenchantment, an ethereal immortal lady

variants.point: serene mysterious look, one hand extended gracefully as if presenting a register beside her

variants.leer: lecherous fawning grin, eyes staring fixedly, leaning forward, rubbing his hands together

keqing.who: Qin Keqing, a beautiful young lady appearing as a ghost in a dream

variants.sorrow: grave, sorrowful and ethereal, melancholy eyes, one hand raised in a solemn warning

jingxu.who: Abbess Jingxu, an elderly Buddhist nun

variants.wheedle: wheedling ingratiating smile, crafty eyes, leaning forward, palms pressed together

jiazheng.who: Jia Zheng, a strict middle-aged official and father

variants.scold: stern and angry, glaring, brows furrowed, pointing a finger to scold
variants.nod: grudgingly approving, faint restrained smile, hands behind his back, slight nod

yuanchun.who: Jia Yuanchun, the Imperial Consort in palace attire

variants.tearful: weeping quietly, eyes red with tears, a handkerchief raised to her eye, sorrowful yet dignified

xiangyun.who: Shi Xiangyun, a cheerful, tomboyish young lady

variants.laugh: hearty open laugh, eyes squeezed happily, hands raised in excitement
variants.pout: playful pout, cheeks puffed, brows raised, hands on hips as if complaining

lengzixing.who: Leng Zixing, a worldly antique dealer from the capital

variants.gossip: gleeful gossiping grin, eyes narrowed with amusement, leaning slightly forward, one finger raised and wagging as if relating a juicy scandal, the wine cup still in the other hand

jiaqiang.who: Jia Qiang, a handsome foppish young master

variants.sly: sly scheming half-smile, eyes glancing sideways, the closed folding fan raised beside his mouth as if whispering instigation

mingyan.who: Mingyan, a brash page boy servant

variants.fierce: fierce and belligerent, mouth wide open shouting, brows knit, one fist raised and the other hand pointing forward aggressively, charging stance

jinshi.who: Madam Huang (nee Jin), a woman from a poor branch of the clan

variants.angry: indignant and huffy, brows knit, lips pressed, chin raised, one hand clutching a handkerchief firmly as if storming off to demand justice
variants.fawn: deflated and ingratiating, awkward placating smile, shoulders lowered, head slightly bowed, hands clasped meekly

qinzhong.who: Qin Zhong, a delicate handsome boy

variants.ill: gravely ill and dying: deathly pale waxen face, eyes half-closed and dim, hair loosened, wearing only a plain white inner robe with a grey quilt-like wrap over the shoulders, body sagging weakly

xiren.who: Hua Xiren, a gentle senior maidservant

variants.firm: feigning cool resolve, face turned slightly away, eyes lowered, lips set firmly, hands folded, as if saying 'my mind is made up'
variants.smile: tender coaxing smile, head tilted, one hand raised gently with a finger lifted as if listing conditions one by one

jiahuan.who: Jia Huan, a sulky boy, son of a concubine

variants.cry: bawling resentfully, face screwed up with tears, one sleeve raised to wipe his eyes, the other fist clenched

variants.pout: aggrieved pout, cheeks puffed, lips pushed out, eyes cast down sulkily, both hands fiddling with her sleeve

beijingwang.who: Shui Rong, the Prince of Beijing, a handsome graceful young prince in a white python robe
